summary: Apply ECMAScript ToLength to lastIndex before global/sticky matching.

target.notes: lastIndex may hold arbitrary JS values. RegExpBuiltinExec performs Get followed by ToLength, clamping negatives/NaN to zero and truncating fractions.

caveats: ToLength can invoke conversion hooks and throw.
Do not use a C# integer cast with different overflow/NaN semantics.

tests.name: negative clamps to zero
tests.input: const r=/a/g; r.lastIndex=-10; const m=r.exec('a'); console.log(m.index,r.lastIndex);

tests.name: fraction truncates
tests.input: const r=/a/g; r.lastIndex=1.9; const m=r.exec('ba'); console.log(m.index,r.lastIndex);
